@chat/apps/frontend/src/components/side-panel/story-code-view.tsx when i double click on a query_id in the code i want the the convo to jump to the corresponding execute_sql (on the sql code)
I'll look at the story code view and how the chat jumps to `execute_sql` tool calls so we can wire double-click on `query_id`.

questions.prompt: When you double-click a query_id in the story code, what should happen in the conversation?

options.label: Scroll to that execute_sql, expand it, and show the SQL query view
Just scroll/highlight the matching execute_sql tool call (don't force expand or switch to SQL view)
Scroll to that execute_sql and expand it (keep current/results view)

content.text: I'll wire double-click on `query_id` in the Monaco editor to scroll the chat to that `execute_sql`, expand it, and show the SQL.
I'll delay the scroll slightly so React can expand the tool call before we jump to it.
I'll widen the hit target so double-clicking anywhere on the `query_id="..."` attribute jumps, not only the value.

Double-clicking a `query_id="…"` in the story code view now jumps the conversation to that `execute_sql` tool call, expands it, and opens the SQL view.

How it works:
1. **Monaco** — double-click on a `query_id="…"` attribute extracts the id
2. **Chat** — finds the matching `execute_sql` (by `output.id`), expands any collapsed tool groups, expands the tool, switches to query view, then scrolls + briefly highlights it
